as_of: 2026-09-20, of3t-orchestrator pass 187 -- a reachability read of the composed branch, CPU only, no measurement
why: the five recipe divergences SS7 found are fixed on `wk/of3t-wirefix`, release-gated and unmerged, and somebody will eventually have to decide whether to land them. That decision turns on blast radius, and I had only checked half of it: I verified `train_loop` has no production callers but not the two changes inside `AdamW`.

the_three_gates_between_these_fixes_and_.finding: `train_loop` is the only thing carrying the changed defaults (weight_decay=0.0, betas=(0.9,0.95), plateau_until=50000) and it has NO production callers -- git grep finds it only in tests, docs and this campaign's own harness.
`AdamW` is constructed in exactly one non-test place in the whole tree: tt_bio/train/recipes.py:134, inside train_loop. Every other construction is a test.

both changes inside AdamW are gated on the per-sample accumulator being non-empty -- `per_sample = bool(self.accum)` at optim.py:192 guarding the participation division, and `if self.accum:` at optim.py:281 guarding _reduce's new branch. self.accum is filled only by train_loop's new one-sample-at-a-time loop, so on any other path both branches are dead code.

what_that_means_for_the_landing_decision: landing the five fixes CANNOT change any shipped inference path, any other model, or any existing caller, because there is no path from a shipped entry point to the changed code. The framing 'a risky merge of training-recipe changes' overstates it: it is a contained change to an entry point nothing currently calls. AdamW's own class default stays weight_decay=0.01, deliberately, so even a future direct constructor is unaffected.
and_the_flip_side_which_must_be_said_in_: the same three gates mean the fixes DELIVER NOTHING until something calls train_loop. SS7 passing is a statement about an entry point no product uses. That is not an argument against landing them -- an unused correct path beats an unused wrong one, and the next thing to call it inherits the fix -- but nobody should read 'the update rule is reproduced' as 'the shipped product now trains correctly'. The shipped product does not train at all.
what_this_does_NOT_settle: whether to land them. That is Moritz's call and this file does not make it -- it removes the blast-radius objection and states the cost of not landing (the next caller of train_loop inherits five divergences if they are dropped). The campaign's standing constraint is unchanged: release-gated, branch only, nothing merged by this row.
